subject: MAP: Acceptance Scenarios, Exit Gates & Final Close Timeline for Soteria POC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tucker <alex.tucker@soteriahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Acceptance Scenarios, Exit Gates & Final Close Timeline for Soteria POC

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (Soteria-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a companion list of proposed acceptance tests (acceptance-test-cases.md). High-level summary below so we have a clear single-source of truth for signoff decisions.

Goal: 2-week POC to validate inference quality and latency at production-like load, with a single go/no-go decision and procurement ready to issue a PO upon green.

Acceptance scenarios (ranked):
- Scenario A (Green): Production parity on quality + latency within SLOs under 2x target traffic — proceed to PO and Dedicated capacity.
- Scenario B (Yellow): Quality good, minor latency delta -> enable KV caching & quantization profile; run 3-day follow-up test prior to PO.
- Scenario C (Red): Concordance below threshold or repeated timeouts -> remediation plan kicks; no PO until verified.

Exit gates (must be met to consider 'Green'):
- Functional: top-3 prompts pass concordance >= 92% vs baseline; no hallucination rate > 2% in sampled set.
- Performance: p95 generation latency <= 450ms at target load; sustained throughput >= 35 req/s per GPU.
- Reliability: error rate <= 0.5% over 24h rolling window.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and data retention settings agreed (see notes).

Acceptance tests (examples):
- Smoke: 1000 random prompts, compare outputs to golden set for concordance and False Positive flags.
- Load: 60m ramp to target QPS (simulate peak window) capturing latency histograms and OOMs.
- Regression: A/B compare outputs vs current vendor baseline on critical intents.

Timeline (proposed):
- Nov 9: Exchange final test dataset and procurement contacts (you)
- Nov 10–11: Run smoke + regression tests (dev infra)
- Nov 12–13: Load test + SLA validation (karthik to lead)
- Nov 15: Final review meeting (30m) -> go/no-go decision; procurement issues PO if Green.

Asks for you: confirm the timeline, provide procurement contact for PO routing, and flag any additional acceptance metrics Soteria needs (data residency, retention SLAs, audit log export cadence).

Attachments: Soteria-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP milestones), acceptance-test-cases.md (test definitions)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

From: Alex Tucker <alex.tucker@soteriahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@soteriahealth.com, Maria Legal <maria.legal@soteriahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance Scenarios, Exit Gates & Final Close Timeline for Soteria POC

Jordan — appreciate the concise plan and attachments. Quick clarifications before we confirm: 

1) Data residency: we need assurance that PII (patient IDs) stays in the US region and is purged after 30 days unless otherwise flagged. Please add this as a non-negotiable acceptance check.
2) Latency: our clinical workflow requires p95 <= 400ms for the short-response path. Can Redwood commit to the mentioned 450ms target or will that need rework?
3) SOC2: can you share evidence or an attestation now so our security team can triage quickly? If SOC2 isn’t available, we’ll need a completed security questionnaire and an offer for a short-term logging/export to our SIEM.

Procurement: procurement@soteriahealth.com is copied — our target for PO issuance is Nov 16 if the POC is green. If Yellow, procurement needs a short memo from you outlining remediation steps and expected timing.

I’ve pasted the key portions of your plan below for my team to reference. We’re aligned on the overall approach, but the p95 requirement and residency note need addressing.

— Alex
Alex Tucker
Sr. Product Manager, Soteria Health
alex.tucker@soteriahealth.com

Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance Scenarios, Exit Gates & Final Close Timeline for Soteria POC — SLA details & acceptance-test specifics

Alex / Jordan — adding technical specifics so the team has a concrete test plan. Per Alex's ask, I called out residency and tightened the p95 target.

Residency / Retention:
- All PII fields will be tokenized on ingest and stored in a US-only region for this POC. Retention policy: 30-day auto-delete for PII; logs that include identifiers will be scrubbed before export unless explicit opt-in is approved. (Link to config: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SoteriaMAPShared)

Performance & SLA targets (POG for POC):
- Target p95 (short path): <= 400ms at nominal traffic. If achieved at 2x target QPS, mark Performance gate as met.
- Throughput: single-GPU sustained 40 req/s at 512-token median length.
- Error rate: <= 0.4% rolling 24h. OOM/eviction events: zero tolerated for green.

Acceptance test definitions (excerpts):
- Concordance Test: run 2k canonical prompts; concordance >= 92% weighted across critical intents; samples and scoring script attached in acceptance-test-cases.md.
- Load Staircase: 15m steps to 2x QPS, capture p50/p95/p99 and tail latency. Pass if p95 <= 400ms for >95% of steps.
- Resilience: introduce transient node loss (kill one inference worker) during a 30m window; failover time must be < 15s and error spike < 1%.

Fallback & remediation (Yellow path):
- If p95 between 400–480ms, activate KV prefix caching and quantization profile Q2, re-run load tests for 24h. If metrics then meet green thresholds, proceed with memo to procurement.

Attachments: soteria-sla-profile.pdf (detailed SLA terms), acceptance-test-cases.md (already sent)

I’ll schedule the load window for Nov 12–13 and share runbooks with your ops lead. Jordan — can you confirm procurement contact and final meeting time for Nov 15?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Reliability, Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]

Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance Scenarios, Exit Gates & Final Close Timeline for Soteria POC — Confirmed

Jordan / Karthik / Grace — thank you. We reviewed Karthik's SLA profile and the residency language satisfies our security team. The narrower p95 target (<= 400ms) is acceptable for Green. Procurement has penciled in Nov 16 for PO issuance contingent on Green.

We confirm the test windows:
- Nov 10–11: smoke/regression (completed by our infra team)
- Nov 12–13: load + SLA validation (Redwood to run; Karthik lead)
- Nov 15, 10:00–10:30 PT: Final signoff meeting — please send calendar invite.

If POC is Yellow, we need a short remediation memo (3 bullets: root cause, remediation action, estimated re-test window). If Red, we will pause and revisit vendor options.

Attached: Soteria-PO-stub.pdf (procurement placeholder). Sending procurement here: procurement@soteriahealth.com.

Next steps for Jordan: share final calendar invite, confirm Redwood contact for PO routing, and add a one-paragraph remediation memo template to the MAP for procurement to accept in case of Yellow.

— Alex
